source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For an existing profile below UI version 57, the migration rewrites existing checked values at six explicit URL/id pairs. The exact string false becomes -moz-missing plus a newline; other present values become empty string. hasValue prevents creation of missing entries. This preserves document/id identity and makes the conversion narrower than all checked state. The comm code proves these writes and startup/version guards; native restoration semantics and runtime persistence were not verified.
title: UI migration 57 rewrites six persisted checked values
